messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":10,"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":10,"text":"The woman who appeared to you a little while ago, whom you saw mourning, and began to comfort her,","verse":41},{"chapter":10,"text":"but now you no longer see the likeness of the woman, but a city under construction appeared to you,","verse":42},{"chapter":10,"text":"and she told you of the death of her son, this is the interpretation:","verse":43},{"chapter":10,"text":"This woman, whom you saw, is Zion, whom you now see as a city being built.","verse":44},{"chapter":10,"text":"She told you that she had been barren for thirty years because there were three thousand years in the world in which there was no offering as yet offered in her.","verse":45},{"chapter":10,"text":"And it came to pass after three thousand years that Solomon built the city and offered offerings. It was then that the barren bore a son.","verse":46},{"chapter":10,"text":"She told you that she nourished him with great care. That was the dwelling in Jerusalem.","verse":47},{"chapter":10,"text":"When she said to you, ‘My son died when he entered into his marriage chamber, and that misfortune befell her,’ this was the destruction that came to Jerusalem.","verse":48},{"chapter":10,"text":"Behold, you saw her likeness, how she mourned for her son, and you began to comfort her for what has happened to her. These were the things to be opened to you.","verse":49},{"chapter":10,"text":"For now the Most High, seeing that you are sincerely grieved and suffer from your whole heart for her, has shown you the brightness of her glory and the attractiveness of her beauty.","verse":50},{"chapter":10,"text":"Therefore I asked you to remain in the field where no house was built,","verse":51},{"chapter":10,"text":"for I knew that the Most High would show this to you.","verse":52},{"chapter":10,"text":"Therefore I commanded you to come into the field, where no foundation of any building was.","verse":53},{"chapter":10,"text":"For no human construction could stand in the place in which the city of the Most High was to be shown.","verse":54},{"chapter":10,"text":"Therefore don’t be afraid nor let your heart be terrified, but go your way in and see the beauty and greatness of the building, as much as your eyes are able to see.","verse":55},{"chapter":10,"text":"Then will you hear as much as your ears may comprehend.","verse":56},{"chapter":10,"text":"For you are more blessed than many, and are called by name to be with the Most High, like only a few.","verse":57},{"chapter":10,"text":"But tomorrow at night you shall remain here,","verse":58},{"chapter":10,"text":"and so the Most High will show you those visions in dreams of what the Most High will do to those who live on the earth in the last days.” So I slept that night and another, as he commanded me.","verse":59}]}
